description: an enormous warlord man in dark red and black spiked plate armour with glowing orange cracks like embers, a dark horned helmet with two curved horns, a thick dark brown beard and glowing red eyes, a belt of small white skulls, a long dark red cloak hanging behind from the shoulders, dark armoured boots, no axe and nothing in the hands, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing and walking to the right, the nose pointing right and only one eye showing, the chest, belly and hips turned fully to the right and not towards the viewer, only the near arm showing, hanging relaxed beside the body with an empty loosely closed hand, the far arm hidden behind the body, the back and shoulders straight and upright, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the tips of the horns to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy
